memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- NAFLD
  - Status: Mild steatosis on ultrasound, ALT 48 U/L (↑), AST 38 U/L, platelet count 210×10⁹/L.
  - Plan: Continue silymarin 140 mg TDS, rosuvastatin 5 mg OD, repeat LFT in 3 months, advise low‑fat diet.
- Iron‑deficiency anaemia
  - Status: Hb 9.2 g/dL (↓), ferritin 12 ng/mL (↓), MCV 78 fL (↓).
  - Plan: Start ferrous sulfate 200 mg OD, review Hb in 6 weeks.
- Generalised anxiety disorder
  - Status: GAD‑7 score 10 (moderate), reports worry about health.
  - Plan: Start escitalopram 5 mg OD, buspirone 5 mg BD, review in 4 weeks.
Weight 68 kg, waist 92 cm (>90 cm cutoff).
Diet advice:
- Breakfast: Whole‑grain toast with egg white, avoid fried foods.
- Lunch: Steamed vegetables, lean fish, small rice portion.
- Dinner: Soup, salad, avoid red meat after 7 pm.

memories.text: I’ve been feeling restless at night and worrying about my blood test results. I find it hard to relax even after taking my meds.
